Name: (CP) More Junimo Plushies
Author: CyanFire
Description:
Adds more Junimo Plushies to the game in different colours!

They are only available to purchase from Robin on the 28th of each season, the large ones start appearing after the vanilla one is found and the small ones once the Movie Theatre has been built! Will you be lucky enough to encounter the copper, silver, gold or iridium plush for purchase?

These behave just like the vanilla versions and are unrotateable.



Sprites by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/73202468]SterlingDraven[/url]: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8531
